label: PE-9(1)
title: Redundant Cabling

statement.prose: Employ redundant power cabling paths that are physically separated by {{ insert: param, pe-09.01_odp }}.

guidance: Physically separate and redundant power cables ensure that power continues to flow in the event that one of the cables is cut or otherwise damaged.

params.label: distance
guidelines: distance by which redundant power cabling paths are to be physically separated is defined;
